RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the August 14, 2007/Sravana 23, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and

Total number of questions — 20
13
Leakages in domes of Jama Masjid,
Delhi
*41. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there are multiple leakages in the domes of
the 17th century old mosque Jama Masjid,
Delhi;
(b) whether Government have made any
assessment of damage caused due to
leakages; and
(c) what is preventing Government to
take immediate remedial measures to
conserve the mosque inspite of allocation
of funds?
CPSEs in the country
*42. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the number of Central Public
Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) at present
functioning in the countryl;
(b) the details of CPSEs conferred with
'Navratna' status and criteria laid down
therefor;
(c) what is the total investment made in
such CPSEs during the year 2006-07 as
compared to the year 2005-06, State-wise
indicating  the total dividend paid to the
Government in the year 2005-06;
(d) what was the total contribution to
Government through dividend, interest and
taxes as on 01.04.2006; and
(e) what is the percentage of share in
GDP which comes from the above
mentioned CPSEs?
Palace on Wheels from Orissa
*43.  MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
 SHRI B.J. PANDA:
 Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to roll out a
Palace on Wheels from Orissa;
(b) if so, the status of the project;
and
(c) what is the action plan of the Central
Government to construct budget hotels at
important townships in Orissa to boost
tourism in the State?

14
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
State-run low cost domestic airlines
*44. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the first
State-run low cost domestic airline is all
set to take wings very shortly to target
truck routes between big cities as also
sectors that are not fully covered by full
service carriers; and
(b) what would be ticket pricing and
whether it would be comparable to those
offered by current LCCs (Low Cost
Carriers)?
Acute shortage of small coins
*45.  SHRIMATI  JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether he is aware that there is at
present acute shortage of small coins in a
number of city markets and commuters/
consumers are facing acute shortage of coins
at the hands of bus conductors, taxi and
scooter drivers and vendors of daily
necessities;
(b) whether the shortage is very sudden;
and
(c) if so, the steps being taken to address
the problem?
Cancellation of duplicate PAN cards
†*46. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 13 lakh
duplicate PAN cards are being cancelled;
(b) by when the Biometric PAN cards
will be issued in order to check duplicate
PAN cards; and
(c) whether current PAN cards will be
valid even after the issuance of Biometric
PAN cards?
Irrigation projects in Andhra Pradesh
*47. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the progress of the ongoing irrigation
projects in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the time-frame for completion, project-
wise;
(c) whether any fresh project proposals
terming as National Importance have been
received from the State Government of
Andhra Pradesh for assistance as a special
package to develop the backward areas of
the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof alongwith
status and the estimated assistance being
earmarked?
Voted and Charged budget estimates
*48. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of voted and charged BEs
and REs of the last three years;
(b) the financial year-wise details of the
Voted and Charged components of the
Supplementary Demands for Grants during
last three years;
(c) whether it is a fact that the charged
component has increased over the years;
and
(d) if so, reasons therefor and measures
to alter the situation?

15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

SHRI KESHUBHAI S. PATEL:

have compelled Government not to grant
any further extension of the time limit

Opposition to the merger of Air India
and Indian
286. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have finalized
the merger of Air India and Indian;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether some employees unions
have opposed the merger; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard?
New Aviation Policy
†287. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a new aviation
policy has been formulated by
Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that Ministry
of Defence have raised some objections with
regard to the newly laid policy; and
(d) if so, the action taken by
Government to overcome the objection of
Ministry of Defence?
Construction of second International
Airport at Mumbai
288. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government gave its
approval for the construction of a second
international airport for Mumbai to be
constructed at Navi Mumbai with private
participation;
(b) whether as per estimate the existing
Mumbai airport will be fully "saturated"
by 2013 and the Ministry felt that a second
airport for Mumbai should be constructed;
and
(c) if so, by when final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Expansion plan of Dabolim Airport
289.  SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the status of expansion plan of
Dabolim Airport;

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the total amount proposed to be
sent;
(c) the amount granted/sanctioned/
allotted to the Airports Authority of India
for the purpose; and
(d) the details of the expansion plan
and time within which each of the items
under the expansion plan are proposed to
be completed?
City-side development of non-metro
airports
290. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
take up city-side development of non-metro
airports in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Orissa Government has
written to the Centre for inclusion of
Bhubaneswar Airport as well in the list, as
Bhubaneswar has emerged as one of the
fastest growing cities in the country, which
is reflected in the rapid growth of its air-
traffic; and
(d) if so, the status thereof, indicating
the time-frame within which it would also
be taken up for city-side development?
Expansion of runway at Madurai
Airport
291. SHRI R. SHUNMUGA-
SUNDARAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) what are the reasons for the delay in
completion of the works on the expansion
of runway and other areas at Madurai
Airport; and
(b) by when the expansion work will be
completed?
Income of Indian
292. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the air
passenger number is increasing every year,
at the same time the income of Indian is
decreasing during the last five years period;
and
(b) if so, what actions have been taken
to enhance the income of Indian?
Airline services to foreign country
from Madurai Airport
293. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
operate service to foreign countries from
Madurai Airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Merchant airports
†294. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are going to
follow, built and operate policy for
construction of new airports in the country
now;
(b) whether it is also being considered
to allow the private companies to built and
operate such airports without any
interference of Government under the
policy named as merchant airports; and

70
(c) the details of the decision taken in
this regard by Government?
Photo identity cards for entry at
airports
295. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to issue new and comprehensive smart
photo identity cards for entry at all major
international and domestic airports of the
country keeping in view the increasing
threat of terrorism;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
such smart cards are likely to be issued;
and
(c) if not, what are the reasons therefor?
Training of Commercial Pilots
